description: This file contains implementations of classes related to AWC (presumably 'Application-Wide Controller') such as AWCStateChangeNotifier and AWCListener, including methods for managing listeners, notifying state changes, and handling window change notifications.

classes.name: AWCStateChangeNotifier
classes.description: Class responsible for managing listeners interested in AWC state changes, adding/removing listeners and notifying them.

classes.name: AWCListener
classes.description: Class that implements listener functionality for window and state change events, forwarding notifications to an associated notifier.

methods.name: void addListener(AWCStateChangeListener * listener)
methods.description: Adds a listener to the notifier if it is not already registered.

methods.name: void removeListener(AWCStateChangeListener * listener)
methods.description: Removes a listener from the notifier.

methods.name: void notify(int req_id,awc::awc_app_state_t app_state,int status,unsigned int pid)
methods.description: Notifies all registered listeners of a state change with specified details.

methods.name: void notifyWindowChange(int window_id VARIABLE_IS_NOT_USED,awc::AWCClient::awc_window_state_t window_state VARIABLE_IS_NOT_USED,unsigned int pid VARIABLE_IS_NOT_USED)
methods.description: Placeholder for window change notification (currently does nothing).

methods.name: void notifyStateChange(int req_id,awc::awc_app_state_t app_state,int status,unsigned int pid)
methods.description: Notifies the associated notifier of a change in app state.

methods.name: void notifyServiceReady()
methods.description: Placeholder for service readiness notification (currently does nothing).
